The criticism of carbon offsetting as a misleading excuse for continued pollution.
The financial difficulties airlines face in reducing emissions.
answer: The criticism of carbon offsetting as a misleading excuse for continued pollution.
explanation: एयरलाइंस पेड़ लगाने (carbon offsets) का दावा करके खुद को 'कार्बन-न्यूट्रल' बताती हैं, लेकिन वैज्ञानिक इसे प्रदूषण फैलाने का 'लाइसेंस' (license to pollute) मानते हैं क्योंकि पेड़ रातों-रात कार्बन नहीं सोखते। यह प्रथा भ्रामक है।
trick: 'However' के बाद वैज्ञानिकों की आलोचना (license to pollute) गद्यांश का मुख्य विचार है। थीम में यह आलोचनात्मक रुख (criticism) शामिल होना चाहिए।
tip: कंपनियों द्वारा 'Green' या 'Carbon-neutral' होने के दावों को पर्यावरण गद्यांशों में अक्सर 'Greenwashing' या 'Misleading excuse' (भ्रामक बहाना) के रूप में दर्शाया जाता है।

passage: In modern workplace culture, employees are often encouraged to 'stay positive' and 'look on the bright side' during times of intense stress or structural layoffs. Psychologists refer to this as 'toxic positivity,' warning that suppressing genuine negative emotions and forcing a cheerful facade can lead to severe emotional exhaustion and long-term psychological distress.
question: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?
options: The proven link between a positive attitude and career success.
The psychological harm caused by the forced suppression of negative emotions.
The strategies for maintaining a cheerful facade during structural layoffs.
The role of psychologists in creating a positive workplace culture.
answer: The psychological harm caused by the forced suppression of negative emotions.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि खराब समय में ज़बरदस्ती खुश रहने (toxic positivity) और अपनी असली भावनाओं को दबाने से इंसान मानसिक रूप से बीमार (psychological distress) हो सकता है।
trick: गद्यांश का ज़ोर 'toxic' (जहरीला) और 'severe emotional exhaustion' (गंभीर भावनात्मक थकान) पर है। थीम को इसी नुकसान (harm) को उजागर करना चाहिए।
tip: मनोविज्ञान (Psychology) के पैसेज में, भावनाओं को 'suppress' (दबाने) को हमेशा हानिकारक (harmful/detrimental) माना जाता है।

passage: The mayor cut the ribbon for the new mega-ecommerce fulfillment center on the edge of town, claiming it would bring 500 new jobs. What the press release failed to mention was the recent city economic report indicating that the opening of the center is projected to cause the closure of over 50 local main-street businesses, resulting in a net loss of 800 jobs within the community.
question: What can be logically inferred about the new fulfillment center?
options: It will ultimately boost the local economy and reduce unemployment.
Its overall economic impact on the town's employment is actually negative.
Local businesses are excited to partner with the mega-ecommerce center.
The mayor is unaware of the city economic report.
answer: Its overall economic impact on the town's employment is actually negative.
explanation: मेयर 500 नई नौकरियों का दावा कर रहे हैं, लेकिन रिपोर्ट के अनुसार इस सेंटर के कारण स्थानीय दुकानें बंद हो जाएंगी और 800 नौकरियां चली जाएंगी। इसका अर्थ है कि समग्र प्रभाव (net impact) नकारात्मक है (500 आए, 800 गए = 300 का नुकसान)।
trick: गणित लगाएँ: 500 नए जॉब्स आए, लेकिन 800 चले गए। 'Net loss of 800 jobs' स्पष्ट रूप से 'Negative impact' (नकारात्मक प्रभाव) को साबित करता है।
tip: नेताओं के दावों ('claim') और छिपी हुई रिपोर्ट ('failed to mention') के बीच तुलना होने पर निष्कर्ष हमेशा रिपोर्ट की सच्चाई (negative reality) होता है।

passage: Telemedicine was hailed during the pandemic as the ultimate democratizer of healthcare, allowing patients to consult specialists from their living rooms. However, recent public health data shows a stark reality: low-income rural populations, who lack high-speed internet and digital literacy, are now experiencing worse health outcomes than before, as local physical clinics continue to close down in favor of digital-first models.
question: What is the central theme of the text?
options: The undisputed success of telemedicine in rural areas.
The technological requirements for setting up a telemedicine clinic.
How the shift to telemedicine exacerbates existing healthcare inequalities for marginalized groups.
The process of closing down physical clinics in favor of digital-first models.
answer: How the shift to telemedicine exacerbates existing healthcare inequalities for marginalized groups.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि टेलीमेडिसिन (ऑनलाइन इलाज) को अच्छा माना गया था, लेकिन इसके कारण गरीब और ग्रामीण लोग (marginalized groups) इलाज से वंचित हो रहे हैं, क्योंकि उनके पास इंटरनेट नहीं है और उनके आसपास के क्लिनिक बंद हो रहे हैं। इससे असमानता (inequality) बढ़ (exacerbates) रही है।
trick: 'However' के बाद दी गई 'stark reality' (कड़वी सच्चाई) ही मुख्य विषय है। गरीब लोगों (low-income) का नुकसान असमानता (inequality) को दर्शाता है।
tip: तकनीक के कारण गरीब या ग्रामीण लोगों को होने वाले नुकसान को 'Digital Divide' (डिजिटल विभाजन) या 'Exacerbating inequalities' (असमानताओं को बढ़ाना) कहा जाता है।

passage: Hollywood studios are increasingly relying on reboots, sequels, and cinematic universes based on decades-old comic books. While these massive franchises guarantee billions at the global box office, independent filmmakers argue that this risk-averse corporate strategy is starving original, thought-provoking cinema of essential funding and suffocating true artistic innovation.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The financial benefits of investing in independent cinema.
The tension between lucrative, risk-averse franchise filmmaking and artistic originality.
The historical evolution of comic book cinematic universes.
The failure of original movies at the global box office.
answer: The tension between lucrative, risk-averse franchise filmmaking and artistic originality.
explanation: गद्यांश में दो चीज़ों का टकराव है: 1) बड़े स्टूडियो जो पैसे के लिए पुराने कॉमिक्स पर फिल्में बनाते हैं (lucrative, risk-averse), और 2) मूल सिनेमा जिसे पैसे नहीं मिल रहे (artistic originality)।
trick: 'While' (जबकि) से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य अक्सर दो विरोधी विचारों (tension) को दर्शाते हैं। थीम इन दोनों के बीच के संघर्ष (tension/conflict) का वर्णन करेगी।
tip: सिनेमा या कला (Art) से जुड़े पैसेज में हमेशा 'Commercialization' (पैसे का लालच) और 'Artistic Innovation' (कलात्मक नवीनता) के बीच तनाव दिखाया जाता है।

passage: The picturesque coastal village of San Marco used to rely on a modest, sustainable fishing economy. Thanks to a viral social media campaign, it now sees 10,000 tourists a day. While the local government celebrates record tax revenues, the actual residents are fleeing. Rents have quadrupled as homes are converted into short-term rentals, and the once-pristine beaches are now littered with plastic waste.
question: What can be inferred about the impact of the viral campaign on San Marco?
options: It successfully transformed the village into a wealthy fishing empire.
It has destroyed the village's livability for locals despite generating government revenue.
It proved that social media is the best way to clean up polluted beaches.
It caused the local government to ban all short-term rentals.
answer: It has destroyed the village's livability for locals despite generating government revenue.
explanation: वायरल अभियान से पर्यटक आए और सरकार को पैसा मिला, लेकिन असल निवासियों का जीना मुहाल हो गया (किराया बढ़ना, कचरा)। निष्कर्ष यह है कि पैसा आने के बावजूद गांव की रहने लायक स्थिति (livability) नष्ट हो गई है।
trick: फायदे (record tax revenues) और नुकसान (residents fleeing, quadrupled rents) की तुलना करें। आम लोगों के लिए नुकसान बहुत भारी है।
tip: जब किसी छोटी जगह पर अचानक बहुत पर्यटक आ जाते हैं और स्थानीय लोगों का नुकसान होता है, तो इसे 'Overtourism' (अति-पर्यटन) कहा जाता है। Inference हमेशा इसके नकारात्मक प्रभावों पर होता है।

passage: When a user downloads a 'free' mobile game, they are often unaware that the app requires access to their contacts, location data, and microphone. The game company then sells this aggregated data to marketing firms, who use it to serve highly targeted behavioral advertisements. As the tech adage goes, 'If you aren't paying for the product, you are the product.'
question: What is the central theme of the passage?
options: The hidden costs of 'free' digital services through the exploitation of user data.
The technological methods used to develop highly targeted behavioral ads.
The benefits of receiving personalized advertisements.
The necessity of reading the terms of service before playing a mobile game.
answer: The hidden costs of 'free' digital services through the exploitation of user data.
explanation: गद्यांश समझाता है कि मुफ्त ऐप्स असल में मुफ्त नहीं होते; वे आपकी निजी जानकारी (डेटा) चुराते हैं और उसे बेचकर पैसा कमाते हैं। यह मुफ़्त सेवाओं की 'छिपी हुई कीमत' (hidden costs) और 'डेटा के शोषण' (exploitation of user data) के बारे में है।
trick: अंतिम मुहावरा ('you are the product') इस बात का सार है कि उपभोक्ता का इस्तेमाल (exploitation) किया जा रहा है।
tip: डेटा गोपनीयता (Data Privacy) वाले गद्यांशों की मुख्य थीम हमेशा 'Data exploitation' या 'Hidden costs of free services' ही होती है।

passage: The standard history curriculum in the region's schools portrays the 19th-century expansion of the empire as a noble mission that brought civilization and modern infrastructure to 'savage' lands. Indigenous historians, however, have recently published translated diaries from their ancestors, detailing brutal land seizures, forced assimilation, and the systemic destruction of ancient trade routes by the imperial army.
question: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?
options: The architectural superiority of 19th-century imperial infrastructure.
The importance of teaching standard history curriculums in schools.
The conflict between the dominant, glorified imperial narrative and the grim historical reality of the colonized.
The methods indigenous historians use to translate ancient diaries.
answer: The conflict between the dominant, glorified imperial narrative and the grim historical reality of the colonized.
explanation: गद्यांश में एक तरफ किताबों में पढ़ाई जाने वाली 'महान' कहानी (glorified narrative) है, और दूसरी तरफ मूल निवासियों के खून-खराबे वाली असली कहानी (grim reality)। थीम इन दोनों के बीच का टकराव (conflict) है।
trick: 'Noble mission' (महान कार्य) का खंडन (However) 'brutal land seizures' (क्रूर कब्जे) से किया गया है। सही थीम दोनों पक्षों (विजेता और शोषित) को दर्शाएगी।
tip: औपनिवेशिक (Colonial) इतिहास वाले पैसेज हमेशा 'History written by victors' (विजेताओं द्वारा लिखा गया इतिहास) और 'Hidden reality' (छिपी हुई सच्चाई) के बीच के तनाव को दर्शाते हैं।

passage: The company's annual restructuring memo announced that they would be 'right-sizing the organization to enhance operational agility and leverage core competencies moving forward.' When employees translated the dense corporate jargon, they realized that the company was simply laying off 20% of its workforce to boost quarterly profits for shareholders.
question: What can be reasonably inferred about the company's restructuring memo?
options: The memo was written to clearly and honestly communicate the company's financial struggles.
The company is using corporate jargon to soften the blow and mask the harsh reality of mass layoffs.
The company plans to hire 20% more workers to enhance operational agility.
The employees misunderstood the memo and there will be no layoffs.
answer: The company is using corporate jargon to soften the blow and mask the harsh reality of mass layoffs.
explanation: कंपनी ने भारी भरकम कॉर्पोरेट शब्दों ('right-sizing', 'agility') का इस्तेमाल किया, जिसका असली मतलब कर्मचारियों को नौकरी से निकालना (layoffs) था। इसका निष्कर्ष यह है कि कंपनी भारी शब्दों के पीछे कड़वी सच्चाई (harsh reality) छिपा रही है।
trick: 'dense corporate jargon' (भारी कॉर्पोरेट शब्दावली) का इस्तेमाल अक्सर बुरी खबरों (जैसे छंटनी/layoffs) को घुमा-फिराकर कहने (soften the blow/mask) के लिए किया जाता है।
tip: Corporate Jargon (कॉर्पोरेट शब्दावली) का उल्लेख जब भी हो, Inference हमेशा 'hiding the truth' (सच्चाई छिपाना) या 'sugarcoating' (कड़वी बात को मीठा बनाना) होता है।

passage: The organic food movement originally started as a grassroots effort to promote pesticide-free, environmentally friendly farming. Today, however, 'organic' has become a premium lifestyle brand. The exorbitant markup on organic produce in high-end supermarkets has effectively priced out low-income families, turning what was supposed to be a public health benefit into a luxury status symbol.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The health benefits of consuming pesticide-free organic produce.
The historical origins of the grassroots organic food movement.
The gentrification and commercialization of organic food, making it inaccessible to the poor.
The financial strategies used by high-end supermarkets to sell organic food.
answer: The gentrification and commercialization of organic food, making it inaccessible to the poor.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि ऑर्गेनिक खाना (जो कभी पर्यावरण के लिए शुरू हुआ था) अब इतना महंगा (premium/exorbitant) हो गया है कि गरीब लोग इसे खरीद नहीं सकते। यह इसके व्यावसायीकरण (commercialization) और पहुँच से बाहर (inaccessible) होने की थीम है।
trick: 'priced out low-income families' (गरीब परिवारों का बाहर हो जाना) और 'luxury status symbol' (विलासिता का प्रतीक) सीधे तौर पर Gentrification (संभ्रांतकरण) को दर्शाते हैं।
tip: जब कोई बुनियादी ज़रूरत की चीज़ (खाना, घर) बहुत महँगी होकर केवल अमीरों के लिए रह जाए, तो उसे 'Gentrification' या 'Inaccessibility' की थीम माना जाता है।

passage: A heavily cited study concluding that processed sugar is essentially harmless to cardiovascular health was recently retracted. Investigative journalists discovered that the lead researchers had received millions of dollars in undisclosed funding from a coalition of major soft drink manufacturers. Following the revelation, public trust in nutritional science took a significant hit.
question: What can be logically inferred from the passage?
options: Processed sugar is actually beneficial to cardiovascular health.
The researchers objectively separated their findings from their funding sources.
Financial conflicts of interest can heavily bias scientific research and manipulate public health guidelines.
Public trust in nutritional science is currently at an all-time high.
answer: Financial conflicts of interest can heavily bias scientific research and manipulate public health guidelines.
explanation: रिसर्च में दावा किया गया था कि चीनी सुरक्षित है, लेकिन पता चला कि रिसर्च करने वालों को कोल्ड ड्रिंक कंपनियों ने पैसे (undisclosed funding) दिए थे। निष्कर्ष यह है कि पैसे के लालच (financial conflicts of interest) ने विज्ञान को भ्रष्ट (bias) कर दिया।
trick: कंपनी का पैसा (Funding from soft drink companies) और अनुकूल परिणाम (Sugar is harmless) एक सीधा रिश्ता बनाते हैं जिसे 'Conflict of Interest' (हितों का टकराव) कहते हैं।
tip: शोध और विज्ञान वाले गद्यांशों में यदि 'Funding' (निधि) या 'Corporate sponsorship' का ज़िक्र हो, तो Inference हमेशा 'Biased Research' (पक्षपाती शोध) होता है।

passage: The international football tournament used to be a celebration of cultural exchange and pure athletic talent. In recent years, however, fans have grown cynical. Host countries spend billions building stadiums that rot after the event, while the organizing committee awards hosting rights to nations with egregious human rights records, purely based on lucrative broadcasting and sponsorship deals.
question: What is the central theme of the text?
options: The architectural brilliance of modern football stadiums.
The corruption and rampant commercialization undermining the integrity of global sports.
The ways in which international tournaments promote global cultural exchange.
The economic benefits of hosting an international football tournament.
answer: The corruption and rampant commercialization undermining the integrity of global sports.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि कैसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय खेल आयोजनों में अब केवल पैसों (sponsorship deals) और भ्रष्टाचार (human rights records) का बोलबाला है, जिसने खेल की मूल भावना (integrity) को नष्ट कर दिया है।
trick: गद्यांश की शुरुआत 'used to be' (ऐसा हुआ करता था) से होती है और 'In recent years, however' (लेकिन हाल के वर्षों में) कहकर पतन (decline/corruption) को दर्शाया गया है।
tip: आधुनिक खेलों (जैसे ओलंपिक, विश्व कप) से जुड़े अनुच्छेदों में मुख्य थीम आमतौर पर 'Commercialization' (व्यावसायीकरण) और 'Loss of integrity' (अखंडता/शुद्धता का नुकसान) ही होती है।

passage: Thrift shopping and buying vintage clothes, once a necessary strategy for low-income individuals, has exploded into a mainstream fashion trend. While this theoretically reduces fast fashion waste, the massive influx of middle-class shoppers has allowed thrift stores to drastically hike their prices. Consequently, the people who actually rely on these stores out of economic necessity can no longer afford to shop there.
question: What can be most reasonably inferred about the vintage fashion trend?
options: It has successfully completely eliminated the fast fashion industry.
It demonstrates how a well-intentioned sustainability trend can inadvertently harm marginalized communities.
It has forced middle-class shoppers to abandon thrift stores due to high prices.
Thrift stores are losing money because of the vintage fashion trend.
answer: It demonstrates how a well-intentioned sustainability trend can inadvertently harm marginalized communities.
explanation: पुराने कपड़े (Thrift shopping) पहनना पर्यावरण के लिए अच्छा है, लेकिन इस ट्रेंड के कारण कीमतें इतनी बढ़ गईं कि गरीब लोग अब कपड़े नहीं खरीद पा रहे हैं। निष्कर्ष यह है कि एक अच्छे इरादे वाले (well-intentioned) ट्रेंड ने अनजाने में (inadvertently) गरीबों (marginalized) को नुकसान पहुँचाया है।
trick: एक तरफ पर्यावरण का फायदा (reduces waste) है, दूसरी तरफ गरीबों का नुकसान (can no longer afford)। यह एक अप्रत्याशित नकारात्मक परिणाम (unintended negative consequence) का उदाहरण है।
tip: जब भी किसी 'ट्रेंड' या 'पॉलिसी' के कारण उन लोगों को नुकसान हो जिनके लिए वह मूल रूप से थी, तो उत्तर में 'Inadvertent harm' (अनजाने में हुआ नुकसान) या 'Unintended consequence' खोजें।

passage: Ride-sharing companies have long promised their human drivers that they are valued 'partners' in the business. Yet, these same companies are currently funneling billions of dollars into autonomous vehicle research. Industry experts note that the moment self-driving cars achieve regulatory approval, the companies will aggressively phase out their human workforce to eliminate labor costs.
question: What can be inferred about the ride-sharing companies' relationship with their drivers?
options: The companies truly value their drivers and plan to keep them employed indefinitely.
The companies view their human drivers merely as a temporary stopgap until automation becomes viable.
The companies are investing in autonomous vehicles to help human drivers navigate better.
The human drivers will eventually become the owners of the autonomous vehicles.
answer: The companies view their human drivers merely as a temporary stopgap until automation becomes viable.
explanation: कंपनियां चालकों को 'पार्टनर' कहती हैं, लेकिन जैसे ही बिना ड्राइवर वाली कारें (autonomous vehicles) पास हो जाएंगी, वे चालकों को नौकरी से निकाल देंगी। निष्कर्ष यह है कि कंपनियां चालकों को केवल तब तक के लिए इस्तेमाल कर रही हैं (temporary stopgap) जब तक तकनीक तैयार नहीं हो जाती।
trick: दावा ('valued partners') और कंपनी के वास्तविक काम ('funneling billions into automation', 'eliminate labor costs') के बीच का विरोधाभास कंपनी के असली और निर्दयी इरादों को स्पष्ट करता है।
tip: Automation (स्वचालन) और नौकरियों (Jobs) से जुड़े पैसेज में हमेशा 'Human labor as disposable' (मानव श्रम को डिस्पोजेबल/अस्थायी मानना) ही मुख्य Inference होता है।

passage: The city council passed a mandate requiring all new residential developments to designate 10% of their units as 'affordable housing.' To comply, a luxury developer built a 50-story high-rise with a lavish lobby, rooftop pool, and gym for the wealthy buyers. However, the affordable units were clustered in the basement, lacked access to the building's amenities, and were accessed through a separate, heavily monitored back alley door known colloquially as the 'poor door.'
question: Which of the following best represents the central theme of the passage?
options: The success of the city council's mandate in integrating different socioeconomic classes.
The architectural challenges of building a 50-story luxury high-rise.
The malicious compliance and socioeconomic segregation practiced by luxury real estate developers.
The benefits of having separate entrances for different types of residents.
answer: The malicious compliance and socioeconomic segregation practiced by luxury real estate developers.
explanation: डेवलपर ने कानून तो माना (affordable housing बनाई), लेकिन उन लोगों को बेसमेंट में रखकर और उनके लिए अलग 'गरीब दरवाज़ा' (poor door) बनाकर उनके साथ भेदभाव (segregation) किया। इसे 'Malicious compliance' (दुर्भावनापूर्ण अनुपालन) कहते हैं।
trick: भले ही कानून का पालन हुआ ('To comply'), लेकिन परिणाम बहुत ही भेदभावपूर्ण और अपमानजनक ('basement', 'poor door') था। थीम इसी सामाजिक भेदभाव (socioeconomic segregation) को उजागर करती है।
tip: जब कोई कंपनी कानून के अक्षर (letter of the law) का पालन करे लेकिन उसकी भावना (spirit of the law) की धज्जियां उड़ा दे, तो उसे 'Malicious Compliance' कहा जाता है।

passage: As virtual reality (VR) technology becomes indistinguishable from real life, a new psychological phenomenon has emerged. Millions of users are spending upwards of 16 hours a day in digital worlds where they are wealthy, successful, and socially adored. Therapists warn that this extreme escapism is causing individuals to completely neglect their real-world responsibilities, leading to physical health decline and the erosion of real-life relationships.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The incredible technological advancements making VR indistinguishable from reality.
The ways in which VR can be used to treat physical health decline.
The danger of extreme digital escapism and its detrimental impact on real-world functioning.
The economic benefits of creating wealthy and successful digital avatars.
answer: The danger of extreme digital escapism and its detrimental impact on real-world functioning.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि कैसे लोग आभासी वास्तविकता (VR) की नकली दुनिया में इतना खो गए हैं (escapism) कि उन्होंने अपनी असली ज़िंदगी, स्वास्थ्य और रिश्तों को बर्बाद (detrimental impact) कर लिया है।
trick: गद्यांश की शुरुआत VR की तारीफ से नहीं, बल्कि एक 'new psychological phenomenon' (नई मनोवैज्ञानिक घटना) और 'Therapists warn' (थेरेपिस्ट की चेतावनी) से होती है, जो इसे खतरे (danger) की थीम से जोड़ती है।
tip: गेमिंग या वर्चुअल रियलिटी (VR) पर आधारित गद्यांशों की थीम अक्सर 'Escapism' (पलायनवाद) और 'Disconnection from reality' (वास्तविकता से कटाव) होती है।

passage: A major fast-fashion retailer recently launched an 'eco-conscious' line of clothing, heavily promoting the fact that the garments are made from 10% recycled plastic bottles. However, environmental watchdogs noted that the remaining 90% of the material is virgin polyester, and the new line is being manufactured in the same unregulated, high-emission factories as their standard collections.
question: What can be most reasonably inferred about the retailer's 'eco-conscious' line?
options: It represents a massive, systemic shift in the company's manufacturing process.
It is a superficial greenwashing tactic designed to appeal to eco-conscious consumers without making meaningful environmental changes.
The company plans to eventually make all its clothing from 100% recycled plastic bottles.
Virgin polyester is actually highly beneficial for the environment.
answer: It is a superficial greenwashing tactic designed to appeal to eco-conscious consumers without making meaningful environmental changes.
explanation: कंपनी केवल 10% रीसाइकिल्ड सामग्री का इस्तेमाल कर रही है, जबकि 90% अभी भी नया प्लास्टिक (virgin polyester) है और कारखाने भी वही पुराने प्रदूषण फैलाने वाले हैं। इसका सीधा निष्कर्ष (inference) है कि यह केवल पर्यावरण के अनुकूल होने का दिखावा (greenwashing) है।
trick: छोटे से सकारात्मक बदलाव (10%) को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर दिखाना और बड़ी बुराई (90% + high emissions) को छिपाना हमेशा 'Greenwashing' (हरित दिखावा) कहलाता है।
tip: जब भी कोई कंपनी पर्यावरण के नाम पर कोई छोटी सी पहल करे लेकिन अपना मुख्य (प्रदूषणकारी) व्यवसाय न बदले, तो उत्तर में हमेशा 'Greenwashing' या 'Superficial' (सतही) खोजें।

passage: In the early 2000s, corporate architects championed the 'open-plan office' as a revolutionary design that would break down hierarchical barriers and foster spontaneous collaboration. Decades later, numerous psychological studies have revealed that these environment actually decrease face-to-face interactions by 70%. Employees, overwhelmed by constant noise and zero privacy, simply put on noise-canceling headphones and isolate themselves digitally.
question: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?
options: The architectural superiority of open-plan offices over traditional cubicles.
The ways in which noise-canceling headphones improve workplace productivity.
The paradoxical failure of open-plan offices to achieve their intended collaborative goals.
The psychological benefits of breaking down corporate hierarchies.
answer: The paradoxical failure of open-plan offices to achieve their intended collaborative goals.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि ओपन-प्लान ऑफिस (बिना दीवारों वाले दफ्तर) सहयोग बढ़ाने के लिए बनाए गए थे, लेकिन असल में उन्होंने लोगों को और अधिक अलग-थलग (isolate) कर दिया। यह उनके इरादे और परिणाम के बीच एक विरोधाभास (paradoxical failure) है।
trick: डिज़ाइन का उद्देश्य (foster collaboration) और उसका वास्तविक परिणाम (decrease interactions by 70%) एक-दूसरे के बिल्कुल विपरीत हैं, जो इसे एक 'Paradox' (विरोधाभास) बनाता है।
tip: जब किसी योजना का परिणाम उसके मूल उद्देश्य के ठीक उल्टा निकले, तो थीम में हमेशा 'Paradox', 'Unintended consequence', या 'Failure of intent' जैसे शब्द आते हैं।

passage: During the company's annual diversity and inclusion seminar, the HR director proudly showcased a slideshow of the company's entry-level hires, featuring a wide array of ethnic and gender diversity. However, an observant employee noticed that a subsequent slide listing the 15 members of the executive board consisted entirely of individuals from the same demographic group, all of whom had attended the same three elite universities.
question: What can be inferred about the company's commitment to diversity?
options: The company has completely solved the issue of workplace inequality.
Diversity is heavily concentrated at the bottom of the corporate ladder, but structural barriers prevent it from reaching leadership levels.
The executive board plans to resign to make way for the diverse entry-level hires.
Elite universities are the only places that teach diversity and inclusion.
answer: Diversity is heavily concentrated at the bottom of the corporate ladder, but structural barriers prevent it from reaching leadership levels.
explanation: निचले स्तर (entry-level) पर बहुत विविधता है, लेकिन कंपनी का शीर्ष प्रबंधन (executive board) पूरी तरह से एक ही वर्ग और समान विश्वविद्यालयों के लोगों से भरा है। इसका निष्कर्ष है कि विविधता केवल निचले पदों तक सीमित है, उच्च पदों पर नहीं।
trick: तुलना (Comparison) देखें: Entry-level (Diverse) बनाम Executive board (Homogeneous)। यह स्पष्ट रूप से 'Glass Ceiling' (अदृश्य बाधा) या संरचनात्मक असमानता (structural barriers) को दर्शाता है।
tip: कॉर्पोरेट गद्यांशों में यदि निचले स्तर और शीर्ष स्तर के बीच भारी अंतर (discrepancy) दिखाया जाए, तो Inference हमेशा 'Structural inequality' (संरचनात्मक असमानता) होता है।

passage: Car manufacturers are increasingly outfitting their new models with built-in hardware for heated seats, advanced navigation, and remote start. However, customers are finding that these features remain electronically locked unless they pay a monthly subscription fee to activate them. Consumer advocates argue that this shifts the relationship between buyer and product, forcing individuals to endlessly rent capabilities that are already physically installed in the car they own.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The technological brilliance of modern car manufacturing.
The economic challenges faced by car manufacturers in the 21st century.
The transition from product ownership to an exploitative subscription-based microtransaction model.
The environmental benefits of locking unused car features.
answer: The transition from product ownership to an exploitative subscription-based microtransaction model.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि कार में पहले से मौजूद चीज़ों के लिए भी अब कंपनियों द्वारा मासिक शुल्क (subscription) लिया जा रहा है, जिससे लोग अपनी ही खरीदी हुई चीज़ के लिए बार-बार पैसे देने को मजबूर हैं (renting capabilities)।
trick: 'forcing individuals to endlessly rent' (लगातार किराए पर लेने के लिए मजबूर करना) और 'already physically installed' (पहले से मौजूद) थीम को 'Exploitative subscription model' (शोषणकारी सब्सक्रिप्शन मॉडल) से जोड़ते हैं।
tip: जब भी किसी खरीदी हुई चीज़ (hardware) के लिए सॉफ़्टवेयर के ज़रिए बार-बार पैसे माँगे जाएं, तो इसे 'Microtransactions' या 'Subscription exploitation' कहा जाता है।

passage: After facing severe backlash for a highly offensive video, the internet influencer posted a carefully edited apology video. In the five-minute clip, she cried without tears, blamed her 'exhaustion' and 'poor mental health' for the mistake, and spent the last two minutes subtly promoting her new line of wellness supplements designed to 'help people cope with stress.'
question: What can be reasonably inferred from the influencer's apology video?
options: She is deeply and genuinely remorseful for her offensive actions.
Her apology is manipulative and primarily serves as a PR tool to deflect blame and generate sales.
Wellness supplements are the best cure for severe exhaustion.
She plans to leave the internet entirely to focus on her mental health.
answer: Her apology is manipulative and primarily serves as a PR tool to deflect blame and generate sales.
explanation: इन्फ्लुएंसर बिना आँसुओं के रोई, अपनी गलती को मानसिक थकान का नाम दिया, और अंत में अपने ही उत्पादों का विज्ञापन (promotion) करने लगी। इसका स्पष्ट निष्कर्ष है कि माफी सच्ची नहीं थी, बल्कि अपनी छवि बचाने और पैसा कमाने की चाल (manipulative PR tool) थी।
trick: दिखावटी हरकतें ('cried without tears') और गलती का बहाना बनाना ('blamed exhaustion') हमेशा यह साबित करते हैं कि व्यक्ति को कोई पछतावा (remorse) नहीं है।
tip: सोशल मीडिया इन्फ्लुएंसर्स की 'माफी' (apology videos) वाले प्रश्नों में, Inference हमेशा 'Insincere' (असच्चा), 'Deflecting blame' (दोष टालना), या 'Opportunistic' (अवसरवादी) ही होता है।

passage: Grocery store layouts are not a matter of convenience; they are meticulously engineered psychological obstacle courses. Essential items like milk and eggs are deliberately placed at the very back of the store. This forces shoppers to navigate through aisles of brightly colored, highly profitable junk food and impulse-buy items, significantly increasing the likelihood that they will purchase items they never intended to buy.
question: Which of the following best represents the central theme of the passage?
options: The nutritional differences between dairy products and junk food.
The logistical challenges of stocking a large grocery store.
The use of spatial design and psychology to manipulate consumer purchasing behavior.
The importance of making a shopping list before going to the supermarket.
answer: The use of spatial design and psychology to manipulate consumer purchasing behavior.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि सुपरमार्केट का डिज़ाइन (दूध-अंडे पीछे रखना, जंक फूड रास्ते में रखना) ग्राहकों के दिमाग से खेलने और उनसे फालतू का सामान खरीदवाने (impulse buy) के लिए सोच-समझकर बनाया जाता है।
trick: 'psychological obstacle courses' और 'forces shoppers' जैसे वाक्यांश सीधे तौर पर उपभोक्ता के साथ होने वाले मनोवैज्ञानिक हेरफेर (manipulation) की ओर इशारा करते हैं।
tip: मार्केटिंग या स्टोर डिज़ाइन से जुड़े गद्यांशों की थीम हमेशा 'Consumer Manipulation' (उपभोक्ता हेरफेर) या 'Psychological Tactics' (मनोवैज्ञानिक रणनीति) होती है।

passage: A major university proudly announced a crackdown on academic dishonesty, deploying a highly advanced AI detection software to scan all student essays. Within a month, hundreds of students were flagged for cheating. However, independent computer scientists later revealed that the software falsely flagged non-native English speakers at a rate of 60%, because their simpler sentence structures closely mimicked the predictable text generation of basic AI models.
question: What can be logically inferred about the university's use of AI detection software?
options: The software successfully eliminated all forms of cheating on campus.
Non-native English speakers are statistically more likely to cheat on essays.
The university's reliance on flawed technology inadvertently penalized a specific, vulnerable demographic.
The university intentionally targeted non-native English speakers to lower their grades.
answer: The university's reliance on flawed technology inadvertently penalized a specific, vulnerable demographic.
explanation: सॉफ्टवेयर ने गैर-देशी अंग्रेजी बोलने वालों (non-native speakers) को गलत तरीके से (falsely flagged) चीटर बता दिया क्योंकि उनकी भाषा सरल थी। इसका निष्कर्ष है कि एक त्रुटिपूर्ण तकनीक (flawed tech) के कारण अनजाने में एक कमज़ोर वर्ग (vulnerable demographic) को सज़ा मिली।
trick: विश्वविद्यालय का इरादा (cheating रोकना) अच्छा था, लेकिन परिणाम (falsely flagging) विनाशकारी रहा। इसे 'Inadvertent penalization' (अनजाने में सज़ा देना) कहा जाता है।
tip: जब भी कोई AI या एल्गोरिदम किसी खास समूह (अल्पसंख्यक, गैर-देशी, गरीब) को गलत तरीके से निशाना बनाए, तो Inference हमेशा 'Algorithmic bias' या 'Unintended discrimination' होता है।

passage: Modern stock trading apps feature bursting digital confetti, colorful leaderboards, and push notifications celebrating even the smallest trades. Financial regulators argue that by borrowing design principles from mobile casinos and video games, these apps are 'gamifying' the stock market. This encourages inexperienced retail investors to treat serious financial risks like a game, often leading to devastating personal financial losses.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The technological advancements in mobile app design.
The ways in which the stock market is essentially a giant casino.
The dangerous gamification of financial platforms and its impact on inexperienced investors.
The financial success of retail investors using modern trading apps.
answer: The dangerous gamification of financial platforms and its impact on inexperienced investors.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि कैसे ट्रेडिंग ऐप्स वीडियो गेम (gamification) की तरह डिज़ाइन किए गए हैं, जो नए निवेशकों (inexperienced investors) को गंभीर वित्तीय जोखिम (devastating losses) उठाने के लिए उकसाते हैं।
trick: 'gamifying the stock market' (शेयर बाजार को गेम बनाना) और 'devastating losses' (विनाशकारी नुकसान) थीम के मुख्य स्तंभ हैं। विकल्प C इन दोनों को सटीक रूप से जोड़ता है।
tip: 'Gamification' (गेमिफिकेशन) का उपयोग जब भी गंभीर चीज़ों (जैसे शेयर बाज़ार, शिक्षा) में किया जाए, तो पैसेज की थीम अक्सर इसके 'खतरों' (dangers/risks) पर ही होती है।

passage: During the televised town hall, a citizen asked the senator a direct question about her plan to address the rising cost of prescription insulin. The senator looked deeply empathetic, stated that 'healthcare is a fundamental human right,' shared a touching anecdote about her grandmother's struggles with illness, and promised to 'keep fighting for everyday families.' She then quickly moved on to the next question.
question: What can be reasonably inferred from the senator's response?
options: She has a detailed, effective plan to lower the cost of prescription insulin.
She used emotional appeals and political platitudes to completely dodge a specific policy question.
Her grandmother was the primary reason she decided to run for the senate.
She believes that insulin should be entirely free for everyone.
answer: She used emotional appeals and political platitudes to completely dodge a specific policy question.
explanation: नागरिक ने 'इंसुलिन की कीमत' पर एक सीधा सवाल पूछा, लेकिन सीनेटर ने एक भावनात्मक कहानी (anecdote) सुनाई और आम राजनीतिक बातें (platitudes) कहकर सवाल टाल दिया। निष्कर्ष यह है कि उसने जानबूझकर मुख्य सवाल का जवाब देने से परहेज (dodge) किया।
trick: सीधा सवाल (Specific question) + गोलमोल भावनात्मक जवाब (Emotional/Vague answer) = Dodging/Deflecting (सवाल से बचना)।
tip: राजनीतिक बहसों (Political debates) में यदि कोई नेता कहानी सुनाए लेकिन कोई ठोस योजना (policy/plan) न बताए, तो Inference हमेशा 'evasion' (बचना) या 'dodging' ही होता है।

passage: Historically, monumental statues were erected in city squares to cement a unified national narrative, often glorifying conquerors and imperial generals. In recent years, a global movement has seen many of these statues toppled, defaced, or quietly relocated to museums. Historians suggest this is not an erasure of history, as critics claim, but rather a public renegotiation of which historical figures deserve to be venerated in modern civic spaces.
question: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?
options: The artistic techniques used to construct 19th-century monumental statues.
The illegal destruction of public property by angry mobs.
The societal reevaluation of historical monuments and the shifting nature of public memory.
The necessity of moving all historical artifacts into highly secure museums.
answer: The societal reevaluation of historical monuments and the shifting nature of public memory.
explanation: गद्यांश मूर्तियों के गिराए जाने की घटना को 'इतिहास मिटाना' (erasure) नहीं, बल्कि समाज द्वारा इतिहास का पुनर्मूल्यांकन (renegotiation/reevaluation) मानता है कि आज के समय में किसे सम्मान मिलना चाहिए।
trick: 'not an erasure of history... but rather a public renegotiation' यह वाक्य गद्यांश का हृदय (core) है। सही थीम इसी 'पुनर्मूल्यांकन' (Reevaluation) को दर्शाएगी।
tip: स्मारकों (monuments) और इतिहास को बदलने वाले गद्यांशों में, थीम हमेशा 'Shifting public memory' (बदलती सार्वजनिक स्मृति) या 'Reevaluating history' (इतिहास का पुनर्मूल्यांकन) होती है।

passage: The creative agency boldly advertised its 'unpaid summer internship program' as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to gain 'invaluable industry exposure' and 'build a world-class portfolio.' However, former interns reported that their actual duties consisted almost entirely of fetching coffee, sorting mail, and doing basic data entry—tasks that taught them nothing about the creative design process.
question: What can be logically inferred about the creative agency's internship program?
options: It is a highly effective stepping stone for a successful career in design.
The agency is using the guise of 'exposure' to exploit young workers for free menial labor.
Former interns are ungrateful for the world-class exposure they received.
Data entry is the most important skill required for a creative design career.
answer: The agency is using the guise of 'exposure' to exploit young workers for free menial labor.
explanation: एजेंसी ने 'सीखने' (exposure) का झांसा देकर बिना वेतन वाले (unpaid) इंटर्न रखे, लेकिन उनसे केवल नौकरों वाले काम (fetching coffee, data entry) करवाए। इसका सीधा निष्कर्ष है कि वे मुफ्त के मज़दूरों (free menial labor) का शोषण (exploit) कर रहे हैं।
trick: वादे ('invaluable exposure') और हकीकत ('fetching coffee') के बीच का विरोधाभास सीधे तौर पर शोषण (exploitation) का मामला है।
tip: 'Unpaid internships' (बिना वेतन की इंटर्नशिप) और 'Exposure' (अनुभव) से जुड़े पैसेज में Inference हमेशा 'Exploitation of free labor' (मुफ्त श्रम का शोषण) होता है।

passage: When automated self-checkout kiosks were first introduced in supermarkets, executives promised they would revolutionize the shopping experience by eliminating lines. Instead, a peculiar shift occurred. Customers are now forced to scan and bag their own groceries, effectively performing the job of a cashier for free, while the store simultaneously hikes product prices and lays off its human staff.
question: What is the central theme of the passage?
options: The technological brilliance and convenience of automated self-checkout kiosks.
The ways in which customers prefer scanning their own groceries.
How corporate automation shifts labor onto the consumer while maximizing corporate profit.
The necessity of training customers to become efficient cashiers.
answer: How corporate automation shifts labor onto the consumer while maximizing corporate profit.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि ऑटोमेशन (सेल्फ-चेकआउट) ने सुविधा देने के बजाय, ग्राहकों से ही कैशियर का काम मुफ्त में करवाना शुरू कर दिया है, जिससे कंपनी को मुनाफा (हटाए गए कर्मचारियों का पैसा और बढ़ी हुई कीमतें) हो रहा है।
trick: कंपनी का वादा (eliminating lines) बनाम असलियत (forcing customers to do unpaid labor). थीम इस बात पर केंद्रित है कि 'ऑटोमेशन' का फायदा केवल कंपनी के मुनाफे (profit) के लिए हुआ है।
tip: तकनीक द्वारा ग्राहकों से काम करवाने (Self-checkout, self-service) वाले अनुच्छेदों में थीम हमेशा 'Shifting labor to consumers' (उपभोक्ताओं पर श्रम का बोझ डालना) होती है।

passage: A popular health and fitness app offers its premium tracking services entirely for free, provided users agree to its 60-page Terms of Service. A cybersecurity journalist recently uncovered that the app actively cross-references users' heart rates, sleep patterns, and location data, and sells this highly sensitive package directly to major health insurance providers.
question: What can be reasonably inferred about the health app's business model?
options: The app makes its money through charitable donations from its users.
The app's primary source of revenue is the covert commodification and sale of deeply personal user health data.
The health insurance providers use the data to offer cheaper premiums to the app's users.
The app requires a 60-page Terms of Service to educate users about their health.
answer: The app's primary source of revenue is the covert commodification and sale of deeply personal user health data.
explanation: ऐप 'मुफ़्त' है लेकिन यूज़र्स का स्वास्थ्य डेटा (heart rate, sleep) सीधे बीमा कंपनियों को बेच रही है। इसका अर्थ है कि ऐप का असली बिजनेस मॉडल यूज़र्स के व्यक्तिगत डेटा को चुपके से बेचना (covert commodification) है।
trick: 'Free app' + 'Selling data to third parties' = 'Commodification of user data' (यूज़र डेटा का व्यवसायीकरण)। 'If it's free, you are the product' यहाँ लागू होता है।
tip: मुफ्त ऐप्स (Free apps) और डेटा प्राइवेसी वाले पैसेज में Inference हमेशा 'Data exploitation' या 'Covert monetization' (छिपकर पैसे कमाना) होता है।

passage: During the devastating global recession, a prominent billionaire went on a highly publicized media tour, tearfully urging the working class to 'tighten their belts' and accept austerity measures for the 'greater good of the nation.' The very next week, financial watchdogs revealed that he had utilized offshore tax havens to shield an additional $500 million of his personal wealth from government taxation.
question: What can be logically inferred about the billionaire's media tour?
options: He is a patriotic citizen willing to sacrifice his own wealth for the nation.
His public pleas for austerity are deeply hypocritical, serving only to protect elite wealth while demanding sacrifices from the poor.
The offshore tax havens were used to fund charities for the working class.
He genuinely believes that tightening belts is the best economic strategy for everyone, including himself.
answer: His public pleas for austerity are deeply hypocritical, serving only to protect elite wealth while demanding sacrifices from the poor.
explanation: अरबपति गरीबों से 'बलिदान' (tighten belts) देने को कह रहा है, लेकिन खुद अपने पैसे को टैक्स से बचाने के लिए विदेशी खातों (offshore havens) में छिपा रहा है। यह स्पष्ट रूप से एक पाखंडी (hypocritical) व्यवहार है जहाँ गरीबों से त्याग माँगा जा रहा है और खुद का पैसा बचाया जा रहा है।
trick: सार्वजनिक भाषण ('austerity for the greater good') और व्यक्तिगत कार्य ('shielding $500 million') के बीच का भारी विरोधाभास पाखंड (Hypocrisy) का सबसे बड़ा सबूत है।
tip: जब अमीर/शक्तिशाली लोग आम जनता से त्याग (sacrifice) की मांग करें लेकिन खुद नियमों से बचें, तो Inference हमेशा 'Hypocrisy' और 'Double standards' (दोहरे मापदंड) होता है।

passage: In recent decades, large media conglomerates have aggressively bought out hundreds of local, independent newspapers across the country. After a buyout, the conglomerate typically fires the local investigative journalists, centralizes the editorial team in a distant city, and fills the local paper with syndicated national stories. Media scholars warn that this creates 'news deserts' where municipal corruption goes completely unchecked.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The financial efficiency and improved reporting brought by media conglomerates.
The ways in which national syndicated stories are more important than local news.
The detrimental impact of media consolidation on local journalism and civic accountability.
The technological challenges of printing newspapers in distant cities.
answer: The detrimental impact of media consolidation on local journalism and civic accountability.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि बड़ी कंपनियों द्वारा छोटे अखबारों को खरीदने (media consolidation) से स्थानीय पत्रकारों की नौकरी चली जाती है और स्थानीय भ्रष्टाचार पर कोई नज़र नहीं रखता (civic accountability खत्म हो जाती है)।
trick: कारण: 'bought out local newspapers' (अखबारों को खरीदना)। प्रभाव: 'corruption goes unchecked' (भ्रष्टाचार बेरोकटोक बढ़ता है)। थीम इन दोनों को जोड़ती है (Detrimental impact on civic accountability)।
tip: 'News deserts' (समाचार रेगिस्तान) और 'Media conglomerates' से जुड़ी थीम हमेशा 'Loss of local accountability' (स्थानीय जवाबदेही का नुकसान) और पत्रकारिता के पतन पर केंद्रित होती है।

passage: A wildly popular energy drink features the word 'FOCUS' in massive, bold letters across the can, accompanied by images of lightning bolts and brain waves. The back of the can, written in 6-point font, lists the primary ingredients as carbonated water, high-fructose corn syrup, and an amount of caffeine equivalent to four cups of coffee, with zero actual vitamins or nootropic compounds.
question: What can be reasonably inferred about the energy drink's branding?
options: The drink is scientifically proven to enhance brain function and focus.
The marketing relies on aggressive visual aesthetics to distract consumers from its unhealthy, basic composition.
High-fructose corn syrup is an advanced nootropic compound.
The company plans to change the font size on the back of the can to be more readable.
answer: The marketing relies on aggressive visual aesthetics to distract consumers from its unhealthy, basic composition.
explanation: एनर्जी ड्रिंक के डिब्बे पर 'फोकस' और 'बिजली' जैसे बड़े-बड़े चित्र (aggressive visual aesthetics) बने हैं, लेकिन बारीक अक्षरों में लिखा है कि इसमें सिर्फ चीनी, पानी और अत्यधिक कैफीन है (unhealthy composition)। इसका अर्थ है कि ब्रांडिंग का काम सिर्फ सच्चाई को छिपाना और ग्राहकों को भ्रमित करना है।
trick: सामने की ब्रांडिंग (FOCUS/Lightning) और पीछे की सच्चाई (Corn syrup/Caffeine) के बीच का अंतर भ्रामक मार्केटिंग (misleading marketing/distraction) को साबित करता है।
tip: पैकेजिंग और 'Fine print' (बारीक अक्षरों) वाले गद्यांशों में Inference हमेशा यही होता है कि उत्पाद के बड़े-बड़े दावे खोखले (empty/superficial) हैं।

passage: Historically, the concept of a 'carbon footprint' was heavily popularized by one of the world's largest oil companies through a massive multi-million dollar advertising campaign. The campaign encouraged everyday citizens to calculate their personal emissions and take shorter showers. Environmental sociologists point out that this was a brilliant psychological maneuver to shift the blame for climate change away from corporate fossil fuel extraction and entirely onto individual consumer choices.
question: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?
options: The genuine commitment of oil companies to fighting global climate change.
The effectiveness of taking shorter showers in stopping global warming.
The corporate manipulation of environmental narratives to deflect systemic accountability.
The mathematical methods used to calculate an individual's carbon footprint.
answer: The corporate manipulation of environmental narratives to deflect systemic accountability.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि 'कार्बन फुटप्रिंट' (व्यक्तिगत प्रदूषण की गणना) का विचार एक तेल कंपनी ने फैलाया था, ताकि लोग खुद को दोषी मानें और असली मुजरिम (तेल कंपनियों) से ध्यान हट जाए। यह कहानी को मोड़ने (manipulation of narrative) और जवाबदेही से बचने (deflecting accountability) का विषय है।
trick: 'brilliant psychological maneuver to shift the blame' (दोष मढ़ने की शानदार मनोवैज्ञानिक चाल) इस पूरे गद्यांश का सार है।
tip: जब बड़ी कंपनियाँ (विशेषकर तेल/प्लास्टिक) आम जनता को पर्यावरण बचाने की सलाह दें, तो इसे 'Deflecting accountability' (जवाबदेही से बचना) या 'Corporate manipulation' कहा जाता है।

passage: The highly exclusive 'Zenith Wellness Retreat' charges $10,000 a week for guests to sleep in rudimentary wooden huts, forage for wild berries, and surrender all electronic devices. Ironically, the retreat is entirely populated by Silicon Valley executives and Wall Street bankers who pay exorbitant sums to temporarily simulate the exact living conditions of the extreme poverty they often perpetuate through their corporate policies.
question: What can be inferred about the nature of the 'Zenith Wellness Retreat'?
options: It is a charitable organization designed to help executives understand the plight of the poor.
It is a highly effective medical facility for curing technology addiction.
It functions as a luxury status symbol where the elite commodify and perform 'simplicity' as a form of exclusive leisure.
It is facing bankruptcy because nobody wants to pay $10,000 to sleep in a wooden hut.
answer: It functions as a luxury status symbol where the elite commodify and perform 'simplicity' as a form of exclusive leisure.
explanation: यह रिट्रीट 10,000 डॉलर लेकर अमीरों को झोपड़ी में सुलाता है। यह कोई असली सादगी नहीं है, बल्कि अमीरों के लिए गरीबी का एक नाटक (commodify simplicity) और विलासिता का प्रतीक (luxury status symbol) है, जिसे केवल वे ही वहन कर सकते हैं।
trick: 'Ironically' (विडंबना यह है कि) के बाद वाला हिस्सा बताता है कि जो लोग नीतियां बनाकर गरीबी बढ़ाते हैं, वही मजे के लिए 'गरीब' बनने का नाटक कर रहे हैं।
tip: जब अमीर लोग सादगी या गरीबी की नकल (simulate) करने के लिए भारी पैसे चुकाते हैं, तो इसे 'Commodification of poverty/simplicity' (गरीबी/सादगी का वस्तुकरण) कहा जाता है।

passage: Over the last decade, numerous Silicon Valley tech titans have given interviews detailing how they severely restrict their own children's access to smartphones, tablets, and social media, often sending them to low-tech, screen-free schools. Meanwhile, these exact same CEOs publicly advocate for their platforms to be deeply integrated into the curriculum of every public school in the nation.
question: What can be most reasonably inferred about the tech CEOs' stance on screen time?
options: They believe public school students are naturally better equipped to handle screen time than their own children.
They are hypocritically protecting their own families from the addictive harms of their products while happily monetizing other people's children.
They send their children to screen-free schools solely because those schools have better sports programs.
They are planning to eventually ban smartphones for everyone, not just their children.
answer: They are hypocritically protecting their own families from the addictive harms of their products while happily monetizing other people's children.
explanation: टेक सीईओ अपने बच्चों को स्क्रीन (फोन/टैबलेट) से दूर रखते हैं, लेकिन चाहते हैं कि देश के बाकी बच्चे स्कूलों में उनके उत्पादों का इस्तेमाल करें। इसका सीधा निष्कर्ष यह है कि वे जानते हैं कि उनके उत्पाद हानिकारक (addictive) हैं, इसलिए वे अपने बच्चों को बचाते हैं लेकिन दूसरों के बच्चों से पैसा (monetize) कमाते हैं।
trick: अपने लिए अलग नियम (screen-free) और दूसरों के लिए अलग नियम (pushing tech in public schools) सीधा पाखंड (Hypocrisy) है।
tip: Tech CEOs और उनके बच्चों की स्क्रीन टाइम की आदतों वाले पैसेज में Inference हमेशा यही होता है: 'They know it's harmful, but sell it anyway' (वे जानते हैं कि यह हानिकारक है, फिर भी बेचते हैं)।

passage: The cognitive phenomenon known as 'GPS amnesia' is becoming increasingly documented by spatial researchers. Before the advent of turn-by-turn smartphone navigation, humans created complex cognitive maps of their environments. Today, by passively following a glowing blue line on a screen, users are effectively bypassing the hippocampus, leading to a documented decline in natural human spatial awareness and memory retention.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The technological brilliance and convenience of modern GPS systems.
The anatomical structure of the human hippocampus.
How over-reliance on technological convenience can degrade innate human cognitive abilities.
The importance of always keeping a physical paper map in your car.
answer: How over-reliance on technological convenience can degrade innate human cognitive abilities.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि जीपीएस (GPS) पर बहुत ज़्यादा निर्भर रहने के कारण इंसानों की रास्ता याद रखने की प्राकृतिक क्षमता (spatial awareness) कम हो रही है। यह तकनीक पर निर्भरता के कारण मानवीय क्षमता के पतन (degrade innate cognitive abilities) का विषय है।
trick: कारण ('passively following a screen') और प्रभाव ('decline in natural memory')। थीम इन दोनों को जोड़कर तकनीक के नकारात्मक प्रभाव को उजागर करती है।
tip: जब भी कोई मशीन इंसानों का काम आसान कर दे लेकिन इंसान उस काम को भूल जाए, तो थीम हमेशा 'Degradation of human abilities due to over-reliance on technology' (तकनीक पर अत्यधिक निर्भरता के कारण मानवीय क्षमताओं का पतन) होती है।

passage: A prominent political candidate's entire campaign slogan was 'Bringing Back Main Street,' promising to support small, family-owned hardware stores and bakeries. A review of the candidate's campaign finance disclosures, however, revealed that 90% of his funding came from a consortium of mega-retailers and global e-commerce conglomerates—the very entities actively driving small businesses into bankruptcy.
question: What can be logically inferred about the political candidate?
options: His campaign slogan is an authentic reflection of his upcoming policy initiatives.
His public pro-small-business stance is a deceptive facade designed to win votes while being secretly beholden to corporate monopolies.
Mega-retailers are secretly planning to invest in small family-owned bakeries.
He intends to use the money from mega-retailers to open his own hardware store.
answer: His public pro-small-business stance is a deceptive facade designed to win votes while being secretly beholden to corporate monopolies.
explanation: राजनेता का नारा छोटे व्यवसायों (Main Street) को बचाने का है, लेकिन उसे 90% पैसा बड़े कॉरपोरेट्स (mega-retailers) से मिल रहा है जो छोटे व्यवसायों को खत्म कर रहे हैं। इसका सीधा अर्थ है कि उसका नारा केवल वोट पाने का एक दिखावा (deceptive facade) है और वह बड़े कॉरपोरेट्स के प्रति वफादार है।
trick: सार्वजनिक नारा ('Bringing Back Main Street') और पैसों का स्रोत ('funded by mega-retailers') आपस में टकराते हैं। राजनीति में पैसा ही असली नीयत तय करता है।
tip: राजनीतिक अभियानों (Campaign finance) से जुड़े प्रश्नों में, राजनेता की वफादारी हमेशा वहीं होती है जहाँ से 'Funding' (पैसा) आता है, न कि जहाँ उसके 'Slogans' (नारे) होते हैं।

passage: Historically, street foods like tacos, pho, and pork buns were affordable staples created by and for the working class. Recently, high-end culinary groups have 'discovered' these dishes, serving 'deconstructed' versions in upscale restaurants for twenty times their original price. Food historians argue that this process strips the cuisine of its cultural context and prices out the very communities that invented it.
question: Which of the following best represents the central theme of the passage?
options: The superior taste and quality of deconstructed street food in high-end restaurants.
The historical origins of tacos and pork buns in working-class neighborhoods.
The culinary gentrification and cultural appropriation of working-class food by the elite.
The financial difficulties faced by upscale restaurants in modern times.
answer: The culinary gentrification and cultural appropriation of working-class food by the elite.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि कैसे अमीरों के रेस्टोरेंट ने गरीबों के खाने (street food) को अपना लिया है, उसकी कीमत 20 गुना बढ़ा दी है, और उस समुदाय को ही इससे दूर कर दिया है जिसने इसे बनाया था। इसे 'Culinary gentrification' (भोजन का संभ्रांतकरण) और 'Cultural appropriation' (सांस्कृतिक विनियोग) कहा जाता है।
trick: सस्ते खाने को महंगा करके बेचना ('twenty times original price') और मूल निवासियों को बाहर करना ('prices out communities') जेंट्रिफिकेशन (Gentrification) के क्लासिक लक्षण हैं।
tip: जब भी किसी आम या गरीब की चीज़ (भोजन, कपड़े, कला) को अमीरों द्वारा बहुत महँगे दामों पर बेचा जाए, तो इसे 'Gentrification' या 'Appropriation' कहा जाता है।

passage: A controversial new text-based therapy app promises '24/7 mental health support at the tap of a button.' Users interact via short text messages rather than face-to-face sessions. While it increases accessibility, clinical psychologists warn that removing vocal tone, facial expressions, and uninterrupted time from the therapeutic process turns deep mental health care into a superficial, 'fast-food' transactional experience.
question: What is the central theme of the passage?
options: The undisputed success of technology in completely curing mental health disorders.
The tension between the convenience/accessibility of digital therapy and the degradation of the therapeutic relationship.
The reasons why face-to-face therapy is too expensive for the average consumer.
The superiority of text-based communication over traditional vocal conversations.
answer: The tension between the convenience/accessibility of digital therapy and the degradation of the therapeutic relationship.
explanation: गद्यांश में टेक्स्ट-आधारित थेरेपी के फायदों (सुविधा/accessibility) की तुलना इसके नुकसानों (गहराई का खत्म होना, 'fast-food' अनुभव) से की गई है। यह सुविधा और गुणवत्ता में गिरावट (degradation of relationship) के बीच का तनाव (tension) है।
trick: गद्यांश 'While it increases accessibility' (सुविधा) से शुरू होकर 'warn that removing... turns into superficial experience' (आलोचना) पर जाता है। थीम इन दोनों बिंदुओं का संतुलन होनी चाहिए।
tip: स्वास्थ्य या शिक्षा में तकनीक के प्रवेश वाले गद्यांशों की थीम हमेशा 'Convenience vs Quality' (सुविधा बनाम गुणवत्ता) का ट्रेड-ऑफ (trade-off) होती है।

passage: The president proudly pointed to the soaring stock market indices as absolute proof that his new economic policies were a resounding success for the nation. However, economists quickly pointed out that the top 10% of the population owns 89% of all stocks. Meanwhile, real wages for the bottom 50% of the workforce have actually declined due to record-high inflation.
question: What can be reasonably inferred from the economists' response?
options: The stock market is a perfect and accurate reflection of the entire nation's economic health.
The president's economic policies have successfully enriched everyone in the country.
Using the stock market as a measure of national success is misleading because it primarily reflects the wealth of the already rich.
The bottom 50% of the workforce should invest their declining wages into the stock market.
answer: Using the stock market as a measure of national success is misleading because it primarily reflects the wealth of the already rich.
explanation: राष्ट्रपति शेयर बाजार की छलांग को देश की सफलता बता रहे हैं, लेकिन अर्थशास्त्रियों ने बताया कि शेयर बाजार का 89% हिस्सा केवल 10% अमीरों के पास है, जबकि आम आदमी की कमाई (wages) कम हो गई है। निष्कर्ष यह है कि शेयर बाजार देश की असली आर्थिक स्थिति (राष्ट्रीय सफलता) का सही पैमाना नहीं है, यह भ्रामक (misleading) है।
trick: शेयर बाजार ऊपर जा रहा है, लेकिन आम आदमी की तनख्वाह नीचे जा रही है। इसका मतलब है कि राष्ट्रपति का दावा (resounding success) झूठा या भ्रामक है।
tip: अर्थव्यवस्था से जुड़े पैसेज में, 'Stock Market' और 'Main Street/Real Wages' के बीच का अंतर हमेशा यह साबित करता है कि 'Stock market is not the economy' (शेयर बाजार पूरी अर्थव्यवस्था नहीं है)।

passage: Social media 'hustle bros' frequently post motivational quotes declaring that 'you have the same 24 hours in a day as Beyoncé.' Sociologists argue that this framing is intensely toxic, as it deliberately ignores the fact that celebrities have armies of chefs, nannies, personal trainers, and assistants to manage their daily lives, whereas the average person spends hours merely commuting, cooking, and doing laundry.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The motivational benefits of comparing oneself to highly successful celebrities.
The time management strategies used by celebrities like Beyoncé.
The critique of 'hustle culture' for ignoring severe socioeconomic inequalities and structural realities.
The necessity of hiring personal assistants to achieve true success in life.
answer: The critique of 'hustle culture' for ignoring severe socioeconomic inequalities and structural realities.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि 'तुम्हारे पास भी बेयोंसे जितने ही 24 घंटे हैं' वाली सोच गलत और ज़हरीली (toxic) है, क्योंकि यह भूल जाती है कि मशहूर हस्तियों के पास पैसे और नौकर (socioeconomic advantages) होते हैं, जबकि आम आदमी को अपने सारे काम खुद करने पड़ते हैं। यह 'हसल कल्चर' की आलोचना (critique) है।
trick: 'deliberately ignores the fact' (इस तथ्य को जानबूझकर नज़रअंदाज़ करता है) यह दर्शाता है कि यह सोच संरचनात्मक सच्चाइयों (structural realities/inequalities) को छिपाती है।
tip: जब भी 'Hustle Culture' (हर वक्त काम करने की संस्कृति) की बात हो, तो थीम हमेशा उसकी आलोचना (Critique) और 'Privilege' (विशेषाधिकार) के अनदेखे होने पर होती है।

passage: The multinational corporation proudly sponsored an elaborate, multi-million-dollar 'Women in Leadership' summit, inviting prominent feminist speakers and flooding social media with empowering hashtags. Yet, an investigative report published the same week revealed that the corporation actively lobbies against national paid maternity leave legislation and pays its female warehouse workers 20% less than their male counterparts.
question: What can be logically inferred about the corporation's 'Women in Leadership' summit?
options: It represents a deep, structural commitment to gender equality across all levels of the company.
It is a performative 'corporate feminism' PR stunt designed to distract from their highly exploitative actual labor practices.
The corporation plans to raise the wages of its warehouse workers after the summit concludes.
The feminist speakers at the summit were unaware of the concept of paid maternity leave.
answer: It is a performative 'corporate feminism' PR stunt designed to distract from their highly exploitative actual labor practices.
explanation: कंपनी महिलाओं के लिए एक बड़ा सम्मेलन (summit) कर रही है और हैशटैग चला रही है, लेकिन असलियत में वह महिलाओं की मैटरनिटी लीव का विरोध करती है और उन्हें 20% कम वेतन देती है। यह स्पष्ट रूप से एक दिखावटी जनसंपर्क स्टंट (performative PR stunt) है जिसे असल शोषण (exploitative practices) छिपाने के लिए किया गया है।
trick: बड़े-बड़े इवेंट्स ('multi-million-dollar summit') और घटिया असलियत ('lobbies against maternity leave', 'pays 20% less') सीधे तौर पर दिखावटी कॉर्पोरेट नारीवाद (Corporate Feminism PR stunt) का उदाहरण हैं।
tip: जब कोई कंपनी किसी सामाजिक मुद्दे (पर्यावरण, नारीवाद, एलजीबीटीक्यू) का विज्ञापन करे लेकिन उसके काम ठीक उल्टे हों, तो इसे 'Performative Activism' (दिखावटी सक्रियता) या 'Washing' (जैसे Greenwashing, Pinkwashing) कहा जाता है।

passage: To combat the rise in shoplifting, the local pharmacy placed all items worth over $10—including baby formula, toothpaste, and deodorant—behind locked plexiglass cabinets. Customers must now press a button and wait up to 15 minutes for an overworked employee to unlock the case. Over the next quarter, shoplifting incidents dropped to zero, but the store's overall revenue plummeted by 40%.
question: What can be reasonably inferred about the store's anti-theft strategy?
options: It was a resounding success because it achieved the primary goal of stopping all shoplifting.
The strategy was so inconvenient for legitimate shoppers that they simply stopped buying products there, causing a pyrrhic victory.
Customers decided they no longer needed baby formula or toothpaste.
The store plans to lock up items worth less than $10 in the next quarter.
answer: The strategy was so inconvenient for legitimate shoppers that they simply stopped buying products there, causing a pyrrhic victory.
explanation: चोरी रोकने के लिए दुकान ने सामान को ताले में बंद कर दिया। चोरी तो रुक गई (0%), लेकिन दुकान की कमाई 40% गिर गई क्योंकि ग्राहकों को 15 मिनट इंतज़ार करना पड़ता था, जिससे तंग आकर उन्होंने वहाँ से सामान खरीदना ही बंद कर दिया। इसे 'पाइरिक विक्ट्री' (ऐसी जीत जिसमें नुकसान बहुत ज़्यादा हो) कहते हैं।
trick: चोरी रुकना एक अच्छी बात है, लेकिन 'revenue plummeted by 40%' (कमाई 40% गिर गई) यह साबित करता है कि यह रणनीति अंततः दुकान के लिए विनाशकारी साबित हुई (pyrrhic victory)।
tip: जब कोई 'सुरक्षा उपाय' (Security measure) इतना कड़ा हो जाए कि वह असली ग्राहकों (legitimate users) को ही भगा दे, तो Inference हमेशा 'Inconvenience outweighing benefits' (फायदे से ज्यादा परेशानी) होता है।

passage: The term 'cottagecore' emerged online as an aesthetic movement celebrating a highly romanticized, idyllic version of rural agricultural life. Influencers post highly stylized photos of themselves baking bread in vintage dresses or reading poetry in flower fields. Rural sociologists note, however, that this trend completely erases the grueling, financially precarious, and deeply isolating reality of actual modern farming.
question: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?
options: The financial benefits of modern agricultural farming.
The ways in which social media can accurately educate people about rural life.
The aesthetic romanticization and commodification of rural life, entirely detached from its harsh realities.
The psychological benefits of baking bread and reading poetry.
answer: The aesthetic romanticization and commodification of rural life, entirely detached from its harsh realities.
explanation: गद्यांश बताता है कि 'कॉटेजकोर' (cottagecore) ट्रेंड गाँव की ज़िंदगी को बहुत सुंदर और काव्यात्मक (romanticized) दिखाता है, लेकिन असल में खेती की ज़िंदगी बहुत कठिन, अकेली और आर्थिक रूप से अस्थिर (harsh realities) होती है।
trick: ट्रेंड की सुंदरता ('highly stylized photos') का खंडन ('erases grueling reality') किया गया है। थीम इसी 'रोमांटिकीकरण' (Romanticization) और 'सच्चाई से कटाव' (detached from reality) पर आधारित है।
tip: सोशल मीडिया के 'Aesthetics' (सौंदर्यशास्त्र/ट्रेंड्स) पर आधारित गद्यांशों की थीम हमेशा यही होती है कि वे असल ज़िंदगी की कड़वी सच्चाई को छिपाते या मिटाते (Erase/Detach) हैं।

passage: A revolutionary new blood testing startup claimed its proprietary machine could run hundreds of complex medical tests from a single drop of blood. The charismatic CEO raised billions of dollars from high-profile investors and graced the covers of major business magazines. Yet, behind closed doors, the machines didn't work at all; the company was secretly running the blood samples through traditional, commercially available machines from other companies.
question: What can be logically inferred about the startup?
options: The CEO was a misunderstood genius whose technology was simply ahead of its time.
The startup was a massive fraud, surviving entirely on charismatic hype and deception rather than working technology.
Traditional blood testing machines are actually superior to modern proprietary machines.
The investors heavily scrutinized the technology before giving the CEO billions of dollars.
answer: The startup was a massive fraud, surviving entirely on charismatic hype and deception rather than working technology.
explanation: स्टार्टअप ने एक बूंद खून से सभी टेस्ट करने का दावा किया और अरबों डॉलर जुटाए, लेकिन असल में उनकी मशीनें काम ही नहीं करती थीं और वे दूसरी कंपनियों की पुरानी मशीनों का इस्तेमाल छुपकर कर रहे थे। इसका सीधा अर्थ है कि यह कंपनी एक बहुत बड़ा धोखा (massive fraud) थी।
trick: बड़े-बड़े दावे ('revolutionary', 'billions of dollars') और उनके पीछे का झूठ ('secretly running through traditional machines') स्पष्ट रूप से धोखाधड़ी (fraud/deception) का मामला है। (यह असल में Theranos घोटाले की कहानी है)।
tip: सिलिकॉन वैली या स्टार्टअप्स के बारे में गद्यांशों में यदि 'Secretly didn't work' (छुपकर काम न करना) जैसी बात हो, तो Inference हमेशा 'Fraud', 'Hype', या 'Deception' (धोखा) होता है।

passage: Many classic animated films from the mid-20th century contain racial stereotypes that are highly offensive by today's standards. Recently, the streaming platform that owns these films decided not to delete or censor the scenes. Instead, they added an unskippable 12-second disclaimer before the film begins, stating that these depictions were wrong then and are wrong now, but are being presented as originally created to acknowledge their harmful history.
question: What is the primary theme of the passage?
options: The importance of censoring and completely erasing offensive art from the past.
The financial cost of editing out offensive scenes from old animated films.
The approach of contextualizing rather than erasing problematic history to promote awareness and accountability.
The argument that mid-20th century racial stereotypes were not actually offensive.
answer: The approach of contextualizing rather than erasing problematic history to promote awareness and accountability.
explanation: स्ट्रीमिंग प्लेटफॉर्म ने पुरानी फिल्मों के आपत्तिजनक हिस्सों (offensive scenes) को काटा (censor/erase) नहीं, बल्कि उनके आगे एक चेतावनी (disclaimer) लगा दी ताकि लोग इतिहास की गलतियों को समझें। यह इतिहास को मिटाने के बजाय उसे संदर्भ (contextualizing) देने का विषय है।
trick: 'decided not to delete' (डिलीट न करने का फैसला) और 'added a disclaimer' (चेतावनी जोड़ना) साफ दर्शाता है कि वे इतिहास मिटा (erase) नहीं रहे हैं, बल्कि उसे संदर्भ (context) दे रहे हैं।
tip: विवादास्पद इतिहास या कला (Controversial history/art) से जुड़े पैराग्राफ्स में, चेतावनी (disclaimer) जोड़ने को हमेशा 'Contextualization' (संदर्भ देना) या 'Accountability' (जवाबदेही) माना जाता है, 'Censorship' (सेंसरशिप) नहीं।
